digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow / pytest matrix job execution
propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs in _build-and-test.yml lacked job-level timeout-minutes and defaulted to 360 minutes, allowing unbounded hangs to persist until manual cancellation cleared the queue.

Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 retained the unfixed per-blob lazy-fetch mechanism (omitting commit 96a0d5c3f) causing sequential git-fetch RPCs that hung for 1.7–4.3 hours on partial clones without up-front blob refill.

test_jira_dc_transport.py::test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract contained an infinite loop in the fake Jira client pagination when _paged_search advanced startAt while FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignored the offset and returned the same non-empty page indefinitely, triggering test timeout.
Setting timeout-minutes: 60 on the pytest matrix job bounds execution within expected healthy range (10–16 minutes) and ensures manual clearing is not required for legitimate test failures.
Fixing FakeJiraClient.search_issues to respect startAt/maxResults pagination parameters eliminated the test timeout on stacked Gerrit changes without code logic changes.
